notes.title: Update v1.0 Live
notes.content:
Hello, folks!

Final update released, The game is in final stage now and the main map (floating island level) with PVP is available, right now the game is ready to be released from early access so there will be small updates after this but nothing major unless you guys suggested something that can make the game more fun before i release the game from early access. 
please send us your feedback and mention all the bugs you face in discussions section. https://steamcommunity.com/app/820530/discussions/

Thanks

notes.title: Floating Island level is now available in Single player mode!
notes.content:
Hi folks!

Update 0.9.2 released with below major points
- Floating Island level is now available in Single player mode!.
-Some other minor changes and fixes.

If you face any problem please inform us in discussions section. https://steamcommunity.com/app/820530/discussions/

notes.title: Update 0.9.1 released
notes.content:
Hi folks!

Update 0.9.1 released with below major points
- All 7 achievements now available, before this patch only 1st achievements was availble.
- Added bonus point when hit 2 enemy unit with one bullet.
- Score bug fixed on co-op mode which some time occurred.
-Some other minor fixes.

If you face any problem please inform us in discussions section. https://steamcommunity.com/app/820530/discussions/

notes.title: Happy to announce Stardust is now live as early access title with Co-op mode
notes.content:
Today I'm happy to announce releasing Stardust VR as Early Access with discount 15% , no major bug expected . with below list of whats available.

- 1 of 2 map (Space war Map) is availble for now.
-Global leaderboard is live but it might be reseted after early access if comunity ask for it so no promising here.
- Co-op mode is available
-PVP is not yet available it will be up in the next few days.
-Floating island level will be available within the next few days.
- some of the achievements still not ready.
 
Don't forget to report bugs in discussion section please. https://steamcommunity.com/app/820530/discussions/

Have fun and let us know your thoughts and feedback.
